agent.wait.title: Render PR wait or cleanup steps
agent.wait.summary: Render wait steps once after PR opens: foreground gh checks or T3 link/watch. Wakes read fresh state without re-arming. Sweep only on session resume; done on land, abandon or handback. Fallback uses gh checks. No network access.

agent.guard.title: Render a done-claim guard configuration
agent.guard.summary: Print a mergeable Stop hook using the installed package companion. Name an adapter or detect exactly one harness. Install the printed entry yourself, preserving existing settings.

route.get.title: Get a role's agent route
route.get.summary: Use the current model at high effort and standard speed. Detect the harness when exactly one adapter matches its environment names, or use current when none or multiple match. Max requires ~/.forge/routing.yaml.
